name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-trees
title: Super Mario World - Trees
description:
A conversion of the forest tileset's foreground trees that works on Layer 3. The trees are a couple pixels wider to work with the palette limitations.

Hiding or removing the status bar is recommended here, like the Remove Status Bar patch .
